source.title: Nonlinear SPDEs and Maximal Regularity: An Extended Survey

method_outcomes.B11: Exact Piola decomposition P[(b.grad)u] = G_b u + P[(u.grad)b-(div b)u] for divergence-free u; all first derivatives of u lie in the geometric Piola generator and the remainder is zero order. Structural reduction only.
method_outcomes.B12: For the nonconstant periodic shear, the flow gradient and pullback metric have determinant one and reciprocal nontrivial eigenvalues; no ellipticity collapse. Restricted geometric analysis only.
method_outcomes.B8: Brownian Holder regularity plus smooth spatial shear gives pathwise parabolic-Dini coefficient oscillation O(r^gamma), dyadically summable. This isolates a non-autonomous endpoint generalized-Stokes/Hodge stability lemma; it does not prove it.

remaining_obligation: Prove or refute source-valid local well-posedness for arbitrary admissible nonzero smooth transport coefficients in a scaling-critical space of smoothness <= -1/2 and determine the optimal threshold. Immediate analytic module: endpoint stability for the Piola-conjugated non-autonomous/random generalized Stokes-Hodge operator plus critical convection and zero-order residual noise.
